text:
marta: heads-up from the nightly stress run: we're seeing a new allocation spike after the 2024-11-02 deploy. looks like a regression in kv write path.
marta: creating this thread to lock owners and decide rollback vs hotfix.
jin: can you paste the spike timeline and the diff that landed? i can start a bisect if needed.
marta: timeline + diff: https://git.internal/redwood/changeset/feat/kv-batched-commit
marta: spike log snippet:
marta: ```
[02:13:01] kv_alloc +120M
[02:13:12] gc_attempt: false
[02:13:18] kv_alloc +200M
[02:13:21] OOM
```
owen: that diff added a buffered commit path. suspect we forgot to decrement a refcount in the batched path. i'll take tracing + unit repro.
infra-bot: incident created: INC-5981 - nightly OOM regression on canary-3 (4 nodes affected)
sre-lead: priority call: decide within 4 hours whether to rollback the change or apply a guard. recommend rollback if we can't get a deterministic repro in 2h.
jin: i'll start a quick bisect on canary-3 and run the small repro harness. if reproducible, hotfix PR is fine; if intermittent, prefer rollback.
owen: repro sketch i'll run:

owen: ```
# repro script: many small writes + occasional batch commit
for i in range(0, 20000):
  put(key=f"k{i}", value=random_bytes(256))
  if i % 500 == 0:
    commit_batch()
  sleep(2ms)
```

marta: owners: owen=tracing + repro, jin=bisect + canary tests, sre-lead=rollback decision & comms. i'll update the frag-ledger row with these owners and ETAs.
jin: ETA: bisect + first reproducible run in 90m. i'll post perf counters if successful.
owen: found a promising trace: commit_batch path holds a shard lock during serialization and increments an aggregator without releasing on error. pushing a minimal guard now.
owen: patch snippet:
nowen: ```
try:
  aggregator.inc()
  serialize_batch()
finally:
  aggregator.dec()
```
jin: nice. if that guard is small and passes unit tests, canary it to canary-3 in 30m.
sre-lead: if canary still spikes after guard, we roll back. i'll prepare rollback PR so it's ready.
infra-bot: metric alert: frag_ratio on canary-3 rose from 0.28 -> 0.63 concurrent with alloc spike.
marta: update to ledger: https://redwood.internal/frag-ledger/rows/1758004321 owners updated. please add 1-line status after your runs.
jin: quick perf counters from first guarded canary run:

jin: ```
kv_alloc_rate: 45k/s
kv_free_rate: 3k/s
frag_ratio: 0.62
p95_latency: 240ms
```

jin: guard reduced alloc slope but didn't prevent frag_ratio climb. continuing deeper trace.
owen: i'll instrument refcount deltas and push artifacts to frag-bucket.
sre-lead: decision timeline: if no clear fix within 3h, we rollback. otherwise continue with canary and collect 4h of metrics.
marta: thanks everyone. final asks: 1) owners add ETAs in the frag-ledger row, 2) jin & owen post artifacts to canary tag, 3) everyone drop a 1-line before the 3h mark. closing once ledger updated. :white_check_mark:
